data.prompt: A striking fantasy logo featuring "Witcher LARP" in large medieval serif lettering with intricate carved ice and aged steel textures. The text displays a cold blue inner glow with chipped silver edges, old gold bevel highlights, and deep black shadows beneath each letter. Behind the main text, a towering Roman numeral "I" rises like a vertical frozen stone monolith, creating a dramatic backdrop that evokes a sword-shaped slab. The composition balances epic fantasy aesthetics with weathered, battle-worn details in a premium gaming style.
